text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyaa-hahaha! To Lady Fine on her joyous 
birthday, we humbly present our grand 
strategy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm... Not sure if this is right, but~ 
...well, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Spring is here! Eating convenience store 
onigiri by the riverbank where the cherry 
blossoms are in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Summer! Napping in an air-conditioned 
room, then looking at thunderheads and 
guessing what shapes they make!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Autumn! Flagging down the stone-baked 
sweet potato truck to buy some! And 
looking at the full moon and saying it's 
so pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Would you mind letting me hear 
the end of it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Winter! We shall set up the kotatsu 
and daringly eat ice cream! Furthermore, 
the one sent to buy it shall be decided by 
rock-paper-scissors!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, this is so wonderful! Just like I 
requested—no, even way beyond my 
expectations! I'm gonna be thrilled all 
year long!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thank goodness! If someone just asks 
for 'ordinary life in Japan,' I really 
wouldn't know where to start!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, look at that! My plan is flawless! 
Allow me to treat you to an absolute 
deluge of "ordinary" to your heart's 
content!
